periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of the black eye patches are oriented at a downward diagonal angle of approximately 30 to 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial plane.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: The patches exhibit an elongated oval shape with a vertical length significantly greater than the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: There is a pronounced downward tapering effect, resulting in a teardrop-shaped morphology where the lowest point is significantly distal to the geometric center of the patch.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are separated by a distance approximately equal to 1.5 times the horizontal width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundaries of the pinnae exhibit smooth, semicircular convex arcs.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced saturation of the ventral and lower-torso fur due to water immersion, creating a high-contrast textural and color differential compared to the dry white fur of the cranial region.
